{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|He's always thinking with his stomach.|[[Weechee Warrick]], about his brother [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Willy]]|<ref name="To Save Deej">{{Ewoks|To Save Deej}}</ref>}}
A '''stomach''' was an organ in many species in which its primary purpose was to digest food. Some species, like the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], had multiple stomachs for slower digestion. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], though, possessed two stomachs<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The term ''stomach'' is frequently misused when referring to the abdomen, especially when individuals are stabbed in this area. More often than not, the stomach is never actually punctured.
